title: Jude and the Protocol
author: August Eriksen
blurb: Mara Hartwell, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
